title: Seminar · Give each field an edition and a relation
question: A graph viewer draws both note edges with arrows. Could a caller write the note into both destinations?
answer: The arrows record candidates. B4 requires the filer to distinguish completed work from future work. An ambiguous old note supplies neither timing decision. Preserve both possibilities for review and leave both target fields unfilled.

title: Seminar · Identify the missing metadata
question: Both records mention Signer P. Why would reusing the role from F8 weaken the audit of F7?
answer: B3 asks for a role attestation for the specific filing. The signer might have held a different role on F8. Citing F8 would prove that another record exists without supplying the premise that F7 requires.

title: Seminar · Resolve an ambiguous destination
question: A suggested mapping sends every note beginning with “Replace” to work_planned. What counterexample would you seek?
answer: Ask for an old shorthand note starting with “Replace” whose author explicitly confirms the work was already completed. If the proposed shortcut misroutes even that case, its assumed link between wording and timing fails.
